items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy named Peekaboo Jimmy. Peekaboo Jimmy was a drummer, and he was a -- and he'd see you and he'd say, 'Well, I've got some gigs for you and he'd take out your book and he'd write all these jobs down

ctx.x: Well, you were with Chick Webb, weren't you?

Yeah, I guess I did. I think I -- see, like I was getting fairly into the business then and I think I just gigged around for a couple of months or so. Because the business was good at that time. You could leave one job and go on another job or just freelance around with different people. There was a guy named Peekaboo Jimmy. Peekaboo Jimmy was a drummer, and he was a -- and he'd see you and he'd say, 'Well, I've got some gigs for you and he'd take out your book and he'd write all these jobs down, a half a dozen…

You played in places like the Bamboo Inn, you know, this was all during Prohibition, and people brought their own liquor there and everybody was selling bootleg liquor there. Were you ever in places that were raided?
